posts.title: Rebuilding the little wizard of Solomon’s Key step by step with Phaser 4 and Arcade Physics
posts.description: Let's rebuild the gameplay of the little wizard from Tecmo’s Solomon’s Key in four playable Phaser 4 steps: a tile room, a wizard measured on the NES original, blocks he creates and destroys, and a key that opens the door. Full commented source code available for free.

posts.title: Porting a PuzzleScript game to the Commodore 64: Heroes of Sokoban in C with Oscar64
posts.description: Did you play Heroes of Sokoban? I ported Jonah Ostroff’s PuzzleScript game to the Commodore 64, writing every rule by hand in C with Oscar64 and checking it move by move against the official engine. Here is how the rules, the hires graphics, the two-color sprite heroes and the undo fit in a few KB, allowing room for customization.

posts.title: Build a HTML5 gravity-flipping platformer like “Gravity Duck” with Phaser 4 and TypeScript
posts.description: Rebuild the classic Flash game Gravity Duck in HTML5 with Phaser 4 and TypeScript, in eleven steps. You start from an array of numbers and end with a complete 40-level platformer with gravity flipping, gravity wells, spikes, moving blocks, crawlers, cannons, homing turrets and pistons.
